annotations.title: List the images in a PDF

description: Use this when the user wants to know which images a PDF contains, how many images are on each page, or their pixel sizes, before extracting them. Takes one attached PDF, optional pages (e.g. "1-3, 8"), optional minimum width and height in pixels, and dedupe (default true), and returns each embedded image with page, pixel size, colour space, bits, compression, whether it will be a JPEG or PNG file, duplicates, and skipped images with the reason. Makes no file. Does not open password-protected PDFs, does not run OCR, and does not render pages or vector drawings as images. Do not use when the user wants the image files (use extract_pdf_images).

dedupe.description: true (default): an image that appears more than once (same image data) is kept once and its repeats are listed as duplicates. false: list and extract each use.

file.description: The PDF whose images you want, e.g. brochure.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

images.description: Image numbers on one page, as list_pdf_images shows them ("image_on_page"), e.g. "4-end" or "2, 5". Use together with pages set to one page. Default: all images.

min_height.description: Leave out images shorter than this many pixels, e.g. 100. Default 1 (keep all).

min_width.description: Leave out images narrower than this many pixels, e.g. 100 to skip small icons. Default 1 (keep all).

name: list_pdf_images
title: List the images in a PDF
